name: Zoyla HTTP Load Testing
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed desktop HTTP load-testing application for Windows, macOS and Linux; run local HTTP/2 load tests with live RPS, latency, throughput and error metrics, saved test configurations, and JSON/CSV export. No software usage quota or expiry is stated.
watch_out: Runs on the user's own computer; CPU, network traffic, test targets and any external infrastructure are not provided free. macOS and Windows installers are not code-signed and may trigger OS security warnings. No hosted load generators are included.
